title: Monthly Rate for a Fitting Cushion Reship — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
## Rate rule

For a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the monthly rate of the reship is:

1. **the fitting item's monthly allowance under the schedule**, when the fitting item's latest coverage-billed line carried at least that allowance a month;
2. **that latest line's own monthly rate**, when it carried less.

Where the enrollment has no coverage-billed line of the fitting item, this rule sets no rate.

## Monthly allowance of the fitting item

| Schedule | Full face mask cushion (A7031) | Nasal mask cushion (A7032) | Nasal pillows pair (A7033) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | 1 a month | 1 a month | 1 a month |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | 2 a month | 2 a month | 2 a month |
| any other schedule | 1 a month | 2 a month | 2 a month |

Put in words: one a month for a full face cushion, two a month on the Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule; two a month for a nasal cushion or nasal pillows; and one a month for any cushion item on the Medicaid Resupply Schedule.

## Monthly rate of the latest line

The fitting item's latest coverage-billed line is the one with the newest ship date. Its monthly rate is its units divided by the months it covered, the months covered being the whole calendar months from its ship date to its covered-through date, plus one for the month it began in.

## Cases (hypothetical lines)

- Nasal style, Commercial HMO schedule. Latest nasal cushion line: 6 units, shipped 5 January, covered through 4 April (3 months), so 2 a month. The allowance is 2 a month; 2 is at least 2, so the reship's monthly rate is the allowance, 2.
- Same patient, latest line 3 units over 3 months, so 1 a month: less than the allowance, so the reship's rate is 1 a month.
- Full face style, Commercial PPO schedule, latest full face cushion line 9 units over 3 months, so 3 a month: at least the allowance of 2, so the rate is 2.
- Full face style, Medicaid schedule, latest line 3 units over 3 months: 1 a month equals the Medicaid allowance of 1, so the rate is 1.
